details:
I am a creator doing world testing using Build and Test in Unity. When I try to open local instances with 2 or more clients, sometimes not all the clients can access the world due to errors such as, "Your connection to VRChat timed out," "Instantiating the scene failed," or "VRChat is not responding." When either of those errors occur, VRChat tries to send me to my home world when I am in local testing mode, which will understandably be blocked with an error message that says that I cannot go to online worlds while in local testing mode. 

Unfortunately, I cannot do much when that error screen pops up as pressing OK or just waiting will cause VRChat to keep attempting to send me to my home world, and reloading the same clients in Unity does not help as the clients who have that error message will not be redirected to the local world again. The only way to fix this is to close all instances of VRChat and rebuild the world in Unity to test again. However, doing this is tedious for some creators that have world that take longer to build.

To address this, there should be a way for creators doing local world testing to reload the local world if an error occurs so they can get back to that world quickly without having to waste time going through the rebuilding process in Unity. If errors such as a connection timeout occur, VRChat must provide a way for creators to reload the local test world and redirect the clients to the test world automatically instead of trying to redirect to the home world and getting blocked every time due to being in local test mode.
title: Reload test worlds in VRChat automatically without rebuilding if loading fails in local test mode
